read: Management met working capital targets for March 2026 (4.1% versus 12% target) but missed FY26 revenue growth (11.8% vs 15% guided). FY27 guidance of 10% to 12% growth in revenue and order inflows falls due next.

What specific factors contributed to the Rs 250 crore ECL provision bump in Q1 FY27?
bull: Working capital ratio reached 4.9% in June 2026, beating the 10% target for FY27.
Offshore wind portfolio expanded to 8 GW capacity with major European order wins.
Order book reached Rs 7.79 trillion in June 2026, up 27% year-on-year.
bear: FY26 revenue grew 11.8%, missing the 15% management guidance.
